FIX-001.description: artifacts.js: keep the replaced URL as previous_url when record changes a non-empty URL to a different one; carry the field through normaliseEntry; an unchanged URL adds nothing; a later record with no --url keeps both url and previous_url

FIX-002.description: design-map.js: add republished(dir, { kind, old, new }) and CLI verb republished --dir D --kind canvas|system --new U [--old U]. For a canvas: set the entry's url to the new one, previous_url to the old, repoint every boards[].canvas equal to the old URL, clear version, synced_at, files and the legacy synced_version (which design-mirror.js check falls back to). For system: set design_system.url and previous_url. validate must still pass

FIX-003.description: Prose rule "Unreadable recorded artifact" in contract §1 (new paragraph after step 4) and a pointer in §3 and §4; design-system.md steps 6-8 and refine-design.md (where it reads the canvas) point at it. The rule (not for /audit-design, not with publish: off): republish only when the read returns not-found or no-access, from docs/ui/<slug>/canvas/ or docs/ui/_design-system/<folder>/; call design-map.js republished and artifacts.js record; add a DECISIONS line naming the old and new URL; never STUCK for this cause; any other read error unchanged

FIX-004.description: design-render.js measure script: mark reused: true on a contrast or target measure whose element has no data-dc-tpl and sits inside .sc-host-x; include reused in the grouping key so reused and drawn misses never merge; skip contrast for an element inside a disabled control; document the new field in the header. audit-design.js MEASURE_SCHEMA gains reused: { type: 'boolean' } so the visual critic's verbatim relay keeps it

FIX-005.description: design-map.js: add caveats(dir) and CLI verb caveats --dir docs/ui/<slug>: returns { items, reused_build_side, sources } from brief.md ## Accessibility caveats bullets and a design.md section 4 line naming reused or library components as build-side; reads only; absent file or heading returns an empty result

FIX-006.description: audit-design.js and audit-design.md: the command runs design-map.js caveats and passes caveats in the workflow args; the record-it hint names ## Accessibility caveats in brief.md exactly; visualFindings ranks per the Decision (drawn high; reused with recorded ruling low + known_caveat: true + "known build-side caveat"; reused unrecorded high with the record-it hint); the report lists the known caveats under VISUAL FINDINGS with the "known build-side caveat" wording

FIX-007.description: refine-design.md no-feedback rule: a VISUAL FINDINGS line marked "known build-side caveat" is not an open finding; it is skipped, and STATE says how many were skipped
